text:
Today's winch lifts a quarter of it.

With every cord at one point, one winch can lift the whole dome, up and down, evenly. But this is the whole weight: the frame and a skin, 2,695 kilograms, 26.4 kilonewtons. Today's winch lifts 25 percent of it. The planned one, 4 times bigger, lifts it with almost nothing to spare. 8 times bigger lifts it twice over, and that is the one to buy. Hang the winch itself at the crossing: pulled from a tree, the line turns at the pulley and loads the X with 37 kilonewtons, not 26. And now every kilogram is at the crossing, so the ropes pull 34: still 5/8 in, with the guys at 47.
